description: Reads the state of the app's own database (bring-your-own-database). "status": the current engine and migration progress: progress {phase, processed, total, left}, cost {reads, writes, bytes, credits} spent so far, pausedForQuota + resumesAt, lastMigration. "validate" (engine + config): tests the connection to the developer's database and changes nothing. Engines and config: mongo {uri, dbName}, turso {url, authToken}, postgres {uri}, mysql {uri}; credentials are stored encrypted and never returned. env "pre" reads the app's pre. Changes nothing; neblla_byodb migrates.
name: neblla_byodb_read
title: Byodb (read)
